#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;
const int MAX = 400010;

vector<ll> fact(MAX), invFact(MAX);

ll modPow(ll a, ll n) {
    if (n == 0) return 1LL;
    ll half = modPow(a, n / 2);
    half = half * half % MOD;
    if (n & 1) half = half * a % MOD;
    return half;
}

struct Triplet {
    ll gcd, x, y;
    Triplet(ll g, ll x0, ll y0) : gcd(g), x(x0), y(y0) {}
};

Triplet extendedGcd(ll a, ll b) {
    if (a == 0) return Triplet(b, 0, 1);
    Triplet t = extendedGcd(b % a, a);
    ll x = t.y - (b / a) * t.x;
    ll y = t.x;
    return Triplet(t.gcd, x, y);
}

ll modInv(ll a, ll m) {
    Triplet t = extendedGcd(a, m);
    if (t.gcd != 1) return -1;
    return (t.x % m + m) % m;
}

void precompute() {
    fact[0] = fact[1] = 1;
    invFact[0] = invFact[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAX; i++) {
        fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD;
        invFact[i] = invFact[i-1] * modInv(i, MOD) % MOD;
    }
}

ll nCr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    ll res = fact[n] * invFact[r] % MOD;
    res = res * invFact[n - r] % MOD;
    return res;
}

void solve() {
    precompute();
    int n;
    ll k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fact[n] << "\n";
        return;
    }
    if (n <= k) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return;
    }
    ll comb = nCr(n, (int)k);
    int cols = n - (int)k;
    ll sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= cols; i++) {
        ll term = nCr(cols, i);
        term = term * modPow(cols - i, n) % MOD;
        if (i & 1) {
            sum -= term;
            if (sum < 0) sum += MOD;
        } else {
            sum += term;
            if (sum >= MOD) sum -= MOD;
        }
    }
    ll ans = (2LL * ((comb * sum) % MOD)) % MOD;
    cout << ans << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    cout.tie(NULL);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
